q_en: How do I apply for an assignment extension?
q_zh: 如何申请作业延期？
a_en: Submit the request through the course platform before the deadline, attach supporting evidence, and the course coordinator decides.
a_zh: 請於截止前在課程平台提交延期申請並附上證明，由課程負責人決定是否批准。

q_en: What happens if I submit coursework late?
q_zh: 作业迟交会有什么后果？
a_en: A late submission is recorded against the deadline; ask the course coordinator how the penalty is applied in your programme.
a_zh: 遲交會按截止時間記錄，具體扣分方式請向課程負責人查詢。

q_en: Can our group ask for more time on the group project?
q_zh: 小组作业可以申请延期吗？
a_en: One member submits a joint request with the group's reasons, and the coordinator sets a single revised deadline for the whole group.
a_zh: 由一名成員代表小組提交申請並說明原因，負責人會為全組設定統一的延期。

q_en: How do I report circumstances that affected my coursework?
q_zh: 课程作业受突发事件影响该怎么申报？
a_en: File a mitigating circumstances form with evidence through student services before the assessment board meets.
a_zh: 請在評核會議前向學生事務處提交特殊情況申報表及證明。

q_en: How do I appeal a final grade?
q_zh: 如何对最终成绩提出申诉？
a_en: Appeal in writing to the programme office within the window stated with your results, setting out the ground of appeal.
a_zh: 成績公佈後請在指定期限內書面向課程辦公室申訴，並說明理由。

q_en: Can I ask for my essay to be re-marked?
q_zh: 可以要求重新评阅论文吗？
a_en: Request a re-mark from the module leader with the marked copy, and a second marker reviews that assessment only.
a_zh: 請連同已評閱的作業向模組負責人提出重評申請，由第二位評閱人只複核該份作業。

q_en: My mark is missing from the gradebook. Who do I contact?
q_zh: 成绩表上没有我的分数，应该找谁？
a_en: Report the missing mark to the module leader and copy the programme office so the record can be checked.
a_zh: 請向模組負責人報告缺分情況並抄送課程辦公室，以便核對記錄。

q_en: How are marks adjusted when a cohort performs unusually?
q_zh: 全班成绩偏低时会如何调整？
a_en: Any scaling is decided by the assessment board and published with the results, and individual staff cannot change marks.
a_zh: 任何分數調整均由評核委員會決定並隨成績公佈，個別教職員無權改動。

q_en: Where can I find the examination timetable?
q_zh: 在哪里查看考试时间表？
a_en: Check the examination section of the student portal and confirm your course code and version of the timetable.
a_zh: 請於學生門戶的考試欄目查看，並核對課程編號與版本。

q_en: Which room is my exam in?
q_zh: 我的考试在哪个课室举行？
a_en: The room is listed beside your seat number on the timetable, and you should arrive early to locate it.
a_zh: 課室與座位號一併列於考試時間表，請提早到場確認位置。

q_en: Two of my exams are scheduled at the same time. What should I do?
q_zh: 两科考试时间重叠怎么办？
a_en: Report the clash to the examinations office as soon as it appears so an alternative sitting can be arranged.
a_zh: 請盡快向考試事務處報告撞期，以便安排替代考期。

q_en: What time does the exam start and how long is it?
q_zh: 考试几点开始、考多久？
a_en: The start time and duration are printed on your personal timetable, and the invigilator's clock governs the sitting.
a_zh: 開始時間與作答時限載於個人時間表，以監考員的計時為準。

q_en: I was ill on the day of my exam. What happens now?
q_zh: 考试当天生病缺席该怎么办？
a_en: Submit medical evidence to student services within the stated period and ask for a deferred sitting.
a_zh: 請在指定期限內向學生事務處提交醫療證明，並申請補考。

q_en: How do I apply for special consideration after an exam?
q_zh: 考试后如何申请特殊考虑？
a_en: Apply through the special consideration form with evidence, and the board decides whether any adjustment applies.
a_zh: 請填寫特殊考慮申請表並附證明，由評核委員會決定是否作出調整。

q_en: Can I sit a deferred exam next semester?
q_zh: 可以下学期补考吗？
a_en: Deferred sittings are arranged by the examinations office in the next available period, so confirm the date with them.
a_zh: 補考由考試事務處於下一個可用考期安排，請向其確認日期。

q_en: What happens if I arrive late to an exam?
q_zh: 考试迟到会怎样？
a_en: Admission after the start is at the invigilator's discretion, and the time lost is not replaced.
a_zh: 開考後能否進場由監考員決定，損失的時間不予補回。

q_en: How do I add a course after the add-drop period?
q_zh: 选课期过后还能加课吗？
a_en: Late additions need the module leader's approval and are processed by the programme office.
a_zh: 逾期加課須經模組負責人同意，並由課程辦公室處理。

q_en: How do I drop a course?
q_zh: 如何退选课程？
a_en: Drop the course in the student portal during the adjustment period, then confirm it with the programme office.
a_zh: 請於選課調整期內在學生門戶退選，並向課程辦公室確認。

q_en: Can I switch to a different tutorial group?
q_zh: 可以换到另一个导修组吗？
a_en: Group changes are limited by room capacity, so ask the module leader, who approves swaps.
a_zh: 導修組受課室名額限制，請向模組負責人申請，由其批准轉換。

q_en: The course I want is full. Is there a waiting list?
q_zh: 想选的课满了，有候补名单吗？
a_en: Join the waiting list in the portal, and places are released to the list in order if students drop out.
a_zh: 請於門戶加入候補名單，如有學生退選會按名單順序補上。

q_en: How can I pay tuition fees?
q_zh: 如何缴交学费？
a_en: Follow the payment notice in the student portal and use one of the methods listed there by the stated deadline.
a_zh: 請依學生門戶的繳費通知，在期限內使用所列方式付款。

q_en: Can I pay my tuition in instalments?
q_zh: 学费可以分期缴付吗？
a_en: Instalment plans are arranged by the finance office on request, so confirm the schedule before the first due date.
a_zh: 分期安排須向財務處申請，並須在首個繳款日前確認計劃。

q_en: Where do I get proof that I have paid?
q_zh: 缴费后在哪里取得证明？
a_en: Download the official receipt from the portal once the payment clears, and the finance office can reissue it.
a_zh: 款項入帳後可在門戶下載正式收據，如需補發請聯絡財務處。

q_en: What happens if my payment is late?
q_zh: 逾期未缴会怎样？
a_en: Contact the finance office before the deadline, and they will explain the options and record any arrangement.
a_zh: 請在期限前聯絡財務處，由其說明可行安排並記錄處理方式。

q_en: Can I get a refund after withdrawing from a course?
q_zh: 退课后可以退款吗？
a_en: Refund eligibility depends on the withdrawal date, so submit the refund form to the finance office with the withdrawal record.
a_zh: 退款資格視退課日期而定，請連同退課記錄向財務處提交退款申請。

q_en: I paid twice. How do I get the extra payment back?
q_zh: 我重复缴费了，怎样取回多付的款项？
a_en: Report the duplicate payment to the finance office with both receipts so the balance can be refunded.
a_zh: 請帶同兩筆繳費記錄向財務處報告重複付款，以辦理退款。

q_en: How long does a refund take to reach my account?
q_zh: 退款多久会到帐？
a_en: The finance office confirms the processing time when it approves the refund, and bank clearing time is additional.
a_zh: 財務處批准退款時會告知處理時間，另需加上銀行結算時間。

q_en: Can the fee for a cancelled field trip be refunded?
q_zh: 取消的考察团费用可以退吗？
a_en: Refunds for cancelled activities are arranged by the organising department rather than the finance counter.
a_zh: 取消活動的退款由主辦部門安排，並非由財務櫃檯處理。

q_en: How do I check my scholarship application status?
q_zh: 如何查询奖学金申请进度？
a_en: The status appears in the scholarship section of the portal once the selection panel has reviewed the application.
a_zh: 遴選委員會審閱後，申請進度會顯示於門戶的獎學金欄目。

q_en: Am I eligible for a bursary?
q_zh: 我符合助学金资格吗？
a_en: Eligibility depends on the criteria published with each scheme, and the student finance team confirms individual cases.
a_zh: 資格取決於各計畫公佈的準則，個別情況請由學生資助組確認。

q_en: What must I do to keep my scholarship?
q_zh: 奖学金要怎样才可以延续？
a_en: Renewal depends on meeting the conditions in your award letter, and the renewal form is submitted each year.
a_zh: 續領須符合獎學金通知書所列條件，並須每年提交續期表格。

q_en: When is the scholarship paid out?
q_zh: 奖学金何时发放？
a_en: Disbursement follows the schedule in the award letter, and the finance office confirms any delay.
a_zh: 發放依獎學金通知書所列時間表，如有延誤請向財務處確認。

q_en: How do I reset my student account password?
q_zh: 忘记学生账户密码怎么办？
a_en: Use the self-service reset in the student portal, and contact the IT service desk if verification fails.
a_zh: 請使用學生門戶的自助重設功能，驗證失敗時聯絡資訊科技服務台。

q_en: My account is locked after several wrong passwords.
q_zh: 多次输入错误后账户被锁定了。
a_en: Account locks are cleared after identity verification at the IT service desk, so bring your student card.
a_zh: 帳戶鎖定須經資訊科技服務台核實身份後解除，請攜帶學生證。

q_en: How do I turn on two-factor authentication?
q_zh: 如何启用双重认证？
a_en: Enrol a device in the security settings of the portal, and the service desk assists if enrolment fails.
a_zh: 請於門戶的保安設定登記裝置，登記失敗可向服務台求助。

q_en: How can I change the email address on my account?
q_zh: 怎样更改账户登记的邮箱？
a_en: Update the contact email in the portal profile, and the change is confirmed to both the old and new addresses.
a_zh: 請於門戶個人資料更新聯絡郵箱，系統會向新舊地址發出確認。

q_en: How can I borrow library books?
q_zh: 如何借阅图书馆书籍？
a_en: Use your student card at the self-service counter, and the due date appears in your loan record.
a_zh: 請以學生證於自助借書機辦理，還書日期會顯示於借閱記錄。

q_en: Can I renew a book I have already borrowed?
q_zh: 借了的书可以续借吗？
a_en: Renew in the library account unless another reader has reserved the title, and the new due date shows immediately.
a_zh: 如無人預約，可在圖書館帳戶續借，新的還書日期會即時顯示。

q_en: How do I use a journal database from home?
q_zh: 在家如何使用期刊数据库？
a_en: Sign in through the library's off-campus access link with your student credentials, and the help desk assists with setup.
a_zh: 請經圖書館的校外訪問連結以學生帳戶登入，設定問題可向諮詢台求助。

q_en: I have a library fine. How do I pay it?
q_zh: 图书馆罚款要怎么缴？
a_en: Fines are settled at the library counter or through the payment option in your library account.
a_zh: 罰款可於圖書館櫃檯繳付，或經圖書館帳戶的繳費功能處理。

q_en: Where can I see my similarity report?
q_zh: 在哪里查看相似度报告？
a_en: The report is released in the assignment folder after submission, and your tutor explains how to read it.
a_zh: 報告會於提交後在作業資料夾內發佈，導師會說明如何解讀。

q_en: How should I cite a source in my report?
q_zh: 报告中应如何引用资料？
a_en: Follow the citation style named in the module guide and list every source in the reference list.
a_zh: 請依模組指引指定的引用格式，並在參考文獻列出所有資料來源。

q_en: I have been accused of plagiarism. What is the process?
q_zh: 被指抄袭会怎样处理？
a_en: The case goes to the academic integrity officer, who invites a written response before a decision is made.
a_zh: 個案會交由學術誠信主任處理，並在決定前邀請你作書面回應。

q_en: Can I reuse my own work from another module?
q_zh: 可以重用另一科的旧作业吗？
a_en: Reuse your own earlier work only with the module leader's permission, and declare it in the submission.
a_zh: 重用舊作須先獲模組負責人同意，並在提交時申報。

q_en: How do I book a counselling appointment?
q_zh: 如何预约辅导面谈？
a_en: Book through student services, and appointments are confidential and can be held online.
a_zh: 請經學生事務處預約，面談內容保密，亦可安排線上進行。

q_en: Can I get extra time in exams because of a disability?
q_zh: 因残障可在考试获得额外时间吗？
a_en: Register with the disability support team early in the term so approved arrangements reach the examinations office.
a_zh: 請於學期初向殘障支援組登記，以便核准安排送交考試事務處。

q_en: I am struggling with stress. Where can I get help?
q_zh: 压力很大，可以到哪里求助？
a_en: Student services offers short-term support and referrals to the counselling team, and urgent cases are seen quickly.
a_zh: 學生事務處提供短期支援並轉介輔導組，緊急個案會盡快處理。

q_en: Is there emergency money for students in hardship?
q_zh: 有经济困难的紧急援助吗？
a_en: The student support fund offers short-term grants, and applications with evidence go through student services.
a_zh: 學生支援基金提供短期補助，請連同證明向學生事務處申請。
